preregistered.observable: per block and iteration, a = (samples with exactly one click in the block's slot that land on an algebra mode) / (samples with exactly one click in the slot), the observable of scripts/qd_packed_mode_swap_analysis.py
preregistered.order: per block set, iterations 0 to 3 run packed, swapped, swapped, packed under the primary seed of each layout (ABBA); iterations 4 and 5 are the replicate arm, one packed and one swapped iteration under the replicate seed of each layout, in the order packed, swapped for an even block set and swapped, packed for an odd one
preregistered.binding: a result iteration binds to its setting by circuit_params and compilation_seed; the two primary repeats of one layout share both and bind in submission order; an iteration that returns no counts holds its slot
preregistered.analysis: --analyze pools the three runs into one table over all 30 blocks; every statistic below is withheld unless all 30 blocks are complete, meaning all six iterations of their set returned counts
preregistered.mesh_identity: the sha256 of each returned computed_circuit; the two primary repeats of a layout request one mesh, and a pair with different digests drops out of the validity statistic; the reading is withheld unless every replicate digest differs from its primary digest
preregistered.validity: per job, per block and layout, z = (a_repeat1 - a_repeat0) / two-sample se of the primary repeats; D = sum z^2 over the job's mesh-identical pairs against chi-square with that many degrees of freedom, drift detected when p < 0.01; a job with no mesh-identical pair withholds the placement reading. D checks that the within-job contrast is internally valid and carries no statement about the earlier hour-scale drift. kappa^2 = max(1, D / dof) of the job scales every binomial variance of that job's blocks
preregistered.mesh_variance: per block and layout, R = a_replicate - a_primary(pooled repeats) has variance 2 sigma^2 + kappa^2 (binomial variances); sigma^2 = max(0, mean over the 60 contrasts of (R^2 - kappa^2 binomial variance) / 2) is the per-seed mesh variance of a
preregistered.placement: per block, delta = (a_swapped_primary + a_swapped_replicate) / 2 - (a_packed_primary + a_packed_replicate) / 2, which under no placement effect has variance sigma^2 plus kappa^2 (sum of the four binomial variances) / 4; z = delta / sqrt(sigma^2 + kappa^2 binomial variance); a block moved beyond the mesh variance when |z| > 4.5; the placement lies beyond the mesh variance when at least 2 blocks do; blocks moved against binomial error alone are those of decide() in scripts/qd_packed_mode_swap_analysis.py on the pooled table
preregistered.slot_predictor: decide() on the pooled packed and swapped table of all iterations of each layout; the slot predictor's r with its Fisher 95 percent interval reads a reversed-sign chip-mode effect when the upper bound is below -0.3, a positive-sign chip-mode effect when the lower bound is above +0.3, and no sign-specific chip-mode reading otherwise
preregistered.comparison: per block, delta_new = a_swapped - a_packed of the pooled table against delta_old of the retained qpu_belenos box_kite_photonic_packed and box_kite_photonic_packed_swapped series; reproduce when Pearson r has a lower bound above 0.3 and the blocks of equal sign beat one half with a one-sided exact binomial p < 0.01; uncorrelated when r has a lower bound at or below 0.3 and an upper bound below 0.7; indeterminate otherwise

reading_table.none / any: no moves: the earlier separation fails
reading_table.beyond / reproduce: moves beyond the mesh variance reproduce the earlier deltas: not hour-scale drift
reading_table.beyond / uncorrelated: moves beyond the mesh variance do not follow the earlier deltas: mesh-specific
reading_table.beyond / indeterminate: moves beyond the mesh variance with the earlier deltas neither reproduced nor excluded: inconclusive
reading_table.within / reproduce: moves within the per-block mesh variance reproduce the earlier deltas: not hour-scale drift, placement per block unresolved
reading_table.within / uncorrelated: moves within the mesh variance do not follow the earlier deltas: mesh-specific
reading_table.within / indeterminate: moves within the mesh variance with the earlier deltas neither reproduced nor excluded: inconclusive

preregistered.interpretation: The design shows whether moving a packed block changes its algebra-mode share by more than that share varies between compiled meshes of one layout, and whether the per-block changes reproduce the changes of the earlier separate jobs. Reproduction rules out hour-scale drift as their source; changes that do not follow the earlier deltas, or that stay within the mesh variance, read as mesh-specific. The slot predictor of the pooled blocks reads the sign of the chip-mode effect. The design does not show how a chip mode changes a share.
